_note: Starting points for 'add a connection of your own' (D-245) — NOT connections.
Choosing one fills the add form; nothing exists until the user's own probe
reaches the server and it answers with its tools. That is the whole point:
we ship the shape, the server supplies the truth.
Every entry's shape was read from a PRIMARY source, on the date its own
`source` names — the vendor's repository or docs — never from a search
summary or another list. The list is short for that reason.
Deliberately absent: servers that authenticate only by OAuth 2.1. Our
transports carry a static credential (D-243), so an OAuth-only server would
be a suggestion that cannot work — worse than no suggestion at all.
No entry names `tools`. Tools come from the server, never from a file.

suggestions.name: xero
suggestions.label: Xero accounting
suggestions.description: Invoices, contacts, bank transactions, and profit-and-loss or trial-balance reports from a Xero organisation.

secrets.XERO_CLIENT_ID: from a Xero Custom Connection app

suggestions.name: notion
suggestions.label: Notion
suggestions.description: Read and search the pages and databases a Notion integration has been given access to.

secrets.NOTION_TOKEN: an internal integration token, starting ntn_

suggestions.name: sentry
suggestions.label: Sentry
suggestions.description: Issues, events and stack traces from a Sentry organisation.

suggestions.name: stripe
suggestions.label: Stripe
suggestions.description: Customers, charges, invoices, subscriptions and balances. Reaches Stripe's own hosted server rather than running anything here.

secrets.STRIPE_API_KEY: a RESTRICTED api key (rk_...), scoped to what the crew may see

suggestions.source: Stripe's own MCP documentation, read 2026-08-24. It prefers OAuth; the restricted-key header is its own documented alternative, and the one this app can carry

suggestions.name: alphavantage
suggestions.label: Alpha Vantage market data
suggestions.description: Quotes, daily and intraday prices, fundamentals, forex, crypto, commodities, economic and technical indicators — read-only, from Alpha Vantage's own hosted server.

secrets.ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY: a free key from alphavantage.co/support — 25 requests a day on the free tier

suggestions.source: the server's own repository, read 2026-08-25. It documents the key only as `?apikey=` in the URL; the Bearer header was measured live the same day (its 401 is RFC 6750, and `Bearer <key>` is answered) and is the form this app carries, because a key inside a URL would sit in the job's own folder (D-242, D-262)
